inputs.share_count_basis: 534,439,918 issued (incl. 4,255,157 shares already issued to the ESOP vehicle that back the pre-IPO options) less 16,266,800 treasury shares cumulatively repurchased to the interim report's latest practicable date (Sept 2026) = 518,173,118. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The HK$468m zero-coupon CB (19,914,804 shares at HK$23.50, ~3x the price, due Jan 2027) is treated as debt at principal, not as shares.
inputs.net_debt_note: total_debt = discounted-bill bank borrowings 81.8 + HK$468m zero-coupon CB at RMB principal 398.2 (HKD/CNY 1.1754; carried at FV 389.7 on the balance sheet, redeemable at par Jan 2027). cash = cash & equivalents 694.1 + time deposits 59.5. EXCLUDED on both sides as working capital: pledged deposits 1,004.0 (712.0 non-current + 292.0 current) and restricted cash 31.5, which secure bills payable 1,103.0 and the discounted bills owed to game developers. Lease liabilities 63.7 excluded (treatment B). All at 30 June 2026.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement, equity-settled share-based payment expenses RMB18,634k (FY2024 116,886k; FY2023 219,368k). No equity-award taxes disclosed (net-share settlement not used). H1 FY2026: nil; a new RSU scheme was adopted 5 Feb 2026 with no grants to date.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow RMB114.8m (shares repurchased); H1 FY2026 a further 66.5m, and HK$32.3m in Jul-Sep 2026. The company is funding the flat count. Buybacks are value-neutral in this model.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1754 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-23T19:32Z. No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check: the HK$468m CB converts to RMB398.2m at this rate against the RMB421.9m the company booked at the 8 Jan 2026 issue-date rate, consistent with HKD weakening against CNY over 2026. Per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z regular HKEX close (Yahoo chart API); 52-week range 7.80-21.72, so the price sits at the bottom of its range
inputs.share_count_date: 2026-09 (interim report latest practicable date; issued count unchanged since 2026-06-30, treasury shares updated for Jul/Sep repurchases)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y CGB risk-free ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5-7%, beta ~1.2-1.3 for a small-cap HKEX-listed Chinese game publisher with a controlling shareholder (50.7%), giving a cost of equity of ~10-11%. Debt is immaterial (CB + bills are <10% of capital), so WACC = 10.5%. The same rate is used in all three scenarios: cyclicality, hit risk and portfolio risk are charged in the flows and the weights, not stacked into the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full lease payment (principal + interest; FY2025 5.8 + 2.2 = 8.0m, H1 FY2026 5.2 + 1.2 = 6.5m) deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path at 0.3% of revenue; lease liabilities (63.7m) excluded from net debt; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 PP&E 19.1 + investment property 2.9 + intangibles 4.0 = 26.0m = 0.6% of revenue; H1 FY2026 19.6m = ~1.0% annualised as licensed-game intangibles ramp).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; the NCI stock (RMB130.0m at 30 June 2026, 3.0% of equity) is deducted once in the equity bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF on the game-publishing business, with the investment portfolio, JVs/associates, accrued tax and NCI carried in the equity bridge (SKILL.md routing: operating company; the matching-asset rule of owner-fcf-adaptations (d) makes this a two-part sum, publishing DCF + balance-sheet items, and the JSON says so). It is NOT a run-rate earnings model: FY2025 net income of RMB1,487m is ~RMB1,803m of fair-value gains on FVTPL investments (Century Huatong, Moore Threads) plus RMB68.6m bank interest; the core publishing business earned roughly RMB80m of EBIT. CORE EBITDA DEFINITION (pre-SBC, post-IFRS16, the figure ebitda_margin_path is anchored to): gross profit less selling & distribution, administrative, R&D, the recurring impairment of prepayments/other receivables (FY2024 135.3, FY2025 124.5 -- a real cost of prepaying developers and channels) and core other expenses, plus government grants and rent, plus SBC and D&A; EXCLUDING fair-value gains/losses, bank interest, FVTPL investment income, share of JV/associate results, FX on the HKD CB, CB transaction costs and impairments of PP&E/goodwill/investment property. On that definition: FY2022 ~6.9%, FY2023 ~8.4%, FY2024 3.6%, FY2025 4.0%, H1 FY2025 15.3%, H1 FY2026 3.4% (RMB 63m on 1,883m revenue). REVENUE has fallen four years running (8,817 -> 6,515 -> 5,580 -> 4,158; H1 FY2026 -6%) as the Legend-IP titles age and management cut promotion spend (S&D 5,622 -> 1,876) for efficiency; growth now comes from mini-program games, overseas (HK revenue +11% in H1; overseas RMB833m in FY2025, +34%) and newly licensed IPs (Yulgang: Awakening OBT July 2026; Space Hunter; Soul Land; Legend of King 2), but the new titles carry IP royalty and co-development revenue share, which is why gross margin fell from 60.5% to 53.2% in H1 FY2026. REPORTED FCF IS NOT USED AS A BASE: operating cash flow is distorted by bills-payable paydown funded from pledged deposits (bills payable 5,640 at FY2022 -> 1,103 at H1 FY2026; the 'decrease in bills payable' line alone was -1,276m in FY2024 and -226m in FY2025) -- a financing-of-payables unwind, not operating burn. last_fcf is recorded per the contract (reported FCF -95.6 less SBC 18.6 less interest 68.6 = -182.8) but the forward build starts from the component margins; a normalised FY2025 owner FCF on those components is roughly RMB 70-100m. CASH TAX: cash tax paid has been tiny (FY2025 7.6m against a 408.7m charge, mostly deferred tax on the FV gains) and tax payable has accumulated to RMB486.2m; the model charges a normal 20% cash rate on publishing EBIT (blend of 15% HNTE and 25% statutory) and deducts the accumulated unpaid balance in the bridge as debt-like, so the shelter is not perpetuated. No management guidance is given beyond the pipeline list; no Analysis.json existed at build time.

equity_bridge.item: FVTPL investments at 30 June 2026 carrying value
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet. At 31 Dec 2025 the portfolio was 2,892.9 of which Century Huatong (002602.SZ, 83.47m shares) 1,424.0 and Moore Threads (688795.SS, 3.325m shares via the CMS Jinglu FoF No.53 single asset management plan) 1,318.8; H1 FY2026 added 439.0 of purchases, 160.0 of disposals and a 225.0 fair-value gain.

equity_bridge.item: Mark-to-market of the two disclosed positions, 30 Jun -> 23 Oct 2026 (estimated)
equity_bridge.note: Yahoo closes: Century Huatong 14.10 -> 11.48 (-18.6%), Moore Threads 716.49 -> 384.18 (-46.4%). On the Dec-2025 share counts the two positions would have been worth ~3,559 at 30 June, above the 3,404 total, so some was sold in H1; the estimate assumes the pair was ~90% of the 30 June balance (3,064) split 33/67 by the 30 June prices, giving -188 and -953. The exact post-June holdings are undisclosed; this is the single largest uncertainty in the valuation and the reason the share price has fallen from HK$21 to HK$8.

equity_bridge.item: Liquidity / concentration haircut, 15% of the marked portfolio (~2,263)
equity_bridge.note: Two positions are ~80%+ of the portfolio; Moore Threads is a Dec-2025 STAR-board IPO held through a managed plan with lock-up and at a speculative multiple; Tanwan's 83m Century Huatong shares are ~1.1% of that company and would take time to exit.

equity_bridge.item: Residual deferred tax on unrealised FVTPL gains after the mark
equity_bridge.note: DTL was 330.0 at 30 June 2026 (mostly on the FV gains). After a ~1,141 mark-to-market loss the remaining unrealised gain is ~180-1,060 depending on which entities (15% HNTE vs 25%) hold which positions; 100 is the midpoint.

equity_bridge.item: Investments in joint ventures and associates at book, less 20%
equity_bridge.note: JVs 320.2 + associates 215.8 = 536.0 at 30 June 2026. Associates include the 42% LP interest in Jiaxing Xukai, which itself holds ~1.1% of Century Huatong (down 19% since June); the LP paid Tanwan a 292.3m dividend in H1 FY2026 (associates fell from 579.3), proving the stakes can be monetised. 20% haircut for unlisted/look-through exposure.

equity_bridge.item: Accrued but unpaid income tax in excess of a normal year's accrual
equity_bridge.note: Tax payable 486.2 at 30 June 2026 against cash tax paid of 7.6m in FY2025 and 8.2m in H1 FY2026; ~36m is a normal current-year accrual on publishing profit, the rest is an accumulated obligation treated as debt-like because the forward build charges a full 20% cash rate.
Balance sheet 30 June 2026; flows are consolidated, so NCI is deducted once here (adaptations rule c).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2026-FY2030 average (-5, -2, +1, +2, +2); historical CAGRs are unusable as a forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR +34.2% (FY2022 1,731.8 -> FY2025 4,185.9) diverges from revenue 3yr CAGR -22.2% (8,817.2 -> 4,158.2) by >50pp. The equity growth is unrealised fair-value gains on the FVTPL portfolio, not retained operating earnings; a large part of it has reversed since 30 June 2026.
historical_growth.notes: History in the filings runs FY2021-FY2025 (five-year summary: FY2021 revenue 5,735.7), so only 3yr CAGRs from the Metrics CSV and a 4yr revenue CAGR from the summary are available. EPS CAGR not computed: FY2022 EPS is not in the CSV and FY2025 EPS of RMB2.79 is ~90% fair-value gains (FY2024 was -0.007), so any figure would be noise. Owner-FCF CAGR not computed: FY2022 owner FCF 1,880.7 (2,112.7 reported - 42.9 SBC - 189.1 interest) to FY2025 -182.8 (-95.6 - 18.6 - 68.6) has a negative endpoint, and both endpoints are dominated by bills-payable swings (FY2022 the payables build inflated OCF to 2,282.5; FY2023-FY2025 the unwind took OCF to -2,349.4, -1,999.6, +122.9). SBC fell from 219.4 (3.4% of revenue, FY2023) to 18.6 (0.45%, FY2025) and nil in H1 FY2026, so the SBC-adjusted and reported series have converged rather than diverged.

base.growth_rationale: H1 FY2026 -6.0%; H2 gets Yulgang: Awakening (OBT 31 Jul 2026), Space Hunter: Awakening (Jul 2026) and the Soul Land / Legend of King 2 launches, but revenue on new titles is recognised over the player relationship period, so FY2026 lands around -5%. FY2027 still negative as the legacy Legend titles keep fading; from FY2028 mini-program, overseas and new-IP growth roughly offsets legacy decline for +1-2%, i.e. a flat real business.
base.margin_rationale: Anchored to FY2025 4.0% and H1 FY2026 3.4% core EBITDA (pre-SBC, post-IFRS16, after the recurring receivable impairments). Recovers to 6% as the new-IP royalty load is absorbed and the smaller promotion base scales, which is the FY2022-FY2023 range (6.9-8.4%) less ~1-2pp for the structurally lower gross margin (57% FY2025, 53% H1 FY2026 vs 72% FY2024).
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 PP&E spend of 207.6 was the Guangzhou office building (construction in progress 203.5) and is not repeated; underlying capex is PP&E ~10-20 plus licensed-game intangibles (H1 FY2026 35.5), so 2.0% in FY2026 fading to 1.2%, slightly above the 1.0% D&A path because the business is capitalising more game licences than it amortises.
base.tax_rationale: 20% cash rate on positive publishing EBIT: blend of 15% high-tech-enterprise and 25% statutory PRC rates. The accumulated unpaid tax (486.2) is deducted in the bridge, so the historical near-zero cash tax is not projected forward.
base.terminal_rationale: 2.0% CNY nominal terminal growth for an aging-IP publisher; the Gordon value at 10.5%/2% is ~12x FCF, so the 12x cap (structurally slower, hit-driven business) and Gordon coincide.

bull.narrative: Two or three of the FY2026-27 launches (Yulgang: Awakening, Soul Land: Legend of Evil Slayer, Legend of King 2, the Jin Yong titles) become durable earners, mini-program and overseas distribution keep compounding at 20-30%, and promotion efficiency from the Luoshu/Hetu placement systems lifts core EBITDA to the 12% that H1 FY2025 (15%) showed is attainable in a good half. SBC grants resume under the 2026 RSU scheme at 0.5%.

bear.narrative: The new titles are hits for their developers, not for Tanwan: royalty-heavy proprietary launches keep gross margin in the low 50s while the Legend web/mobile titles that still produce most gross billings decline 10%+ a year, and promotion spend cannot be cut further without accelerating the decline. Core EBITDA of 2% barely covers SBC, leases, D&A and capex, so publishing FCF is ~zero and the operating business is worth roughly nothing; value is the balance sheet alone. This scenario is also where the 30% bear weight carries the portfolio risk the scenario-invariant bridge cannot: a further 30-40% fall in Moore Threads and Century Huatong would take another RMB ~1.3-1.7/share (HK$1.5-2.0) off every scenario.

scenario_narratives.base: A shrinking-then-flat publisher: FY2026 -5% on an H1 of -6%, FY2027 -2%, then +1-2% as mini-program, overseas (Hong Kong +11% in H1 FY2026, overseas RMB833m in FY2025) and the licensed-IP pipeline offset the fading Legend titles. Core EBITDA recovers from 3.4-4.0% to 6% as the royalty load on the new titles is absorbed; cash tax normalises at 20%. The publishing business is worth roughly RMB 1.3bn (about a third of value); the rest is net cash and the investment portfolio marked to 23 Oct 2026 and haircut for concentration and tax.
scenario_narratives.bull: Pipeline conversion: Yulgang: Awakening, Soul Land and Legend of King 2 each sustain, overseas and mini-program distribution compound, and AI-driven placement efficiency lifts core EBITDA to 12% on revenue back above RMB 6bn by FY2032. Terminal cap 15x.
scenario_narratives.bear: Aging-IP decline with a worse cost structure: revenue halves again over six years, core EBITDA settles at 2%, publishing FCF is ~zero and the equity is worth its net cash plus the (volatile, concentrated) portfolio less tax and NCI.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: revenue has fallen four consecutive years, H1 FY2026 core EBITDA margin halved year-on-year, the bridge is scenario-invariant so the bear weight also has to carry the downside of a portfolio that is ~80% two volatile A-share/STAR names (Moore Threads is already -46% since the balance-sheet date), and governance is a 50.7% controlling shareholder who is funding AI-equity investments with convertible debt. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent launches to succeed simultaneously and the H1 FY2026 gross-margin fall shows the new-IP cost structure is worse than the legacy one. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the game-publishing business on normalised owner FCF built from core margins (fair-value gains, interest income, JV results and the bills-payable working-capital unwind all stripped), and carry every stripped income stream's source asset in the bridge at a marked, haircut value: the FVTPL portfolio marked from 30 June to 23 Oct 2026, JVs/associates at book less 20%, less residual deferred tax, the accumulated unpaid tax liability and NCI. FY2025's RMB1.49bn net income is not earnings; the publishing business earned ~RMB80m of EBIT. The CB is debt (conversion price HK$23.50 against a HK$8 share). Count held flat with SBC expensed; buybacks are funding it.
key_risks_to_valuation: Portfolio mark: the post-June holdings of Century Huatong and Moore Threads are undisclosed; the -1,141 mark-to-market is an estimate on Dec-2025 share counts scaled to the 30 June balance. Each further 10% move in the pair is ~RMB 0.45/share (HK$0.5).
Moore Threads lock-up and exit: a 0.7% stake in a recent STAR-board IPO held through a single asset management plan may not be saleable at the screen price; the 15% haircut may be light.
Legacy-IP decay: Legend-series titles still produce most self-run gross billings; the base case assumes decline slows to ~flat by FY2028, which has not yet shown up in any half.

New-IP economics: proprietary/licensed titles carry royalty and co-development revenue share (gross margin 72% -> 57% -> 53%); if the mature margin is 4% rather than 6%, the publishing business is worth ~RMB 0.8bn less.

Cash tax and tax payable: RMB486m accrued, unpaid; treated as debt-like here. If it is settled sooner, or if realising portfolio gains crystallises the DTL at 25%, cash leaves faster than the model's 20% forward rate implies.

Capital allocation: management used CB proceeds to buy AI-themed equities and has not paid a dividend since FY2023; the discount the market applies to the portfolio is itself a judgment on how the cash will be used.

Bills-payable / pledged-deposit structure: bills payable 1,103 are secured by 1,004 of pledged deposits; both are left in working capital. A disorderly unwind would be a cash call, not a value transfer, but the gross exposure is ~RMB2/share.
